steps.name: focused-gate2-verification
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=11b02749fd5896e47ec01d03bcca333be2dea810; git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"; export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=1; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-gate2-verify -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug >/tmp/gate2-verify-cmake.log; cmake --build build/host-gate2-verify --target stage28d_lamp_safety_tests --parallel 1; ./build/host-gate2-verify/stage28d_lamp_safety_tests; git diff --check

verify_steps.name: full-quality-gate
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=11b02749fd5896e47ec01d03bcca333be2dea810; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; export CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL=1; bash scripts/quality_gate_push.sh; git diff --check; printf 'GATE2_VERIFY_COMPLETE commit=%s outputs=fake-locked rf_tx=0\n' "$EXPECTED"
